mcq_drop.why: vague DPI/economy figures 'reported to', not exam-style
opinion 'best expresses' item with trivially absurd distractors
obscure news trivia (security researchers' UMANG report)

pyq_bad.why: garbled: explanation text in place of stem/options

patterns: APPSC asks single-fact identification: NeGP 2006 = 27 MMPs, e-Pramaan = national e-authentication, e-Pragati = AP comprehensive e-governance.
AP-specific items dominate: MeeSeva, e-Pragati, Mana Mitra (30 Jan 2025), NCeG at Visakhapatnam, MeeSeva agent counts.
Current-affairs style 'which company/organisation launched X' (DIKSHA - Bharti Airtel, APAAR full form) recurs.
Match-the-pair traps: Khajane (treasury) vs Bhoomi (land records); SARATHI vs VAHAN.
App MCQs track these well but add many ABDM/DPI statistics and multi-statement items deeper than PYQs.
